title: IRC LAN service binds to 192.168.0.251
content: For the planned LAN IRC bridge/couch-steering support in transcript-search, the LAN-facing IRC server must bind explicitly on 192.168.0.251, e.g. Docker port mapping `192.168.0.251:6667:6667`. The `bro-irc` bridge can still talk to blackboxd on localhost; the IRC service is the LAN-exposed surface.
